verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government IP-office portal offering online filing services, and a built-in AI assistant or chatbot is a plausible feature for such a portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one. The documentation covers only patent, trademark and design procedures, online filing guides and appointment scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
